Hi {{lead.First Name:default=Friend}},
We missed you at yesterday's webinar on "Smarter A/R for a Global Market: AI, Automation, and Cross-Border Payments with Dynamics 365 ERPs," but we didn't want you to miss out on the valuable insights shared.
Watch the Full Recording Access the complete session here <[[https://msdynamicsworld.com/video/smarter-ar-global-market-ai-automation-and-cross-border-payments-dynamics-365-erps?check_logged_in=1]]> - discover how leading finance teams are revolutionizing their collections process.
What You'll Learn:
- Eliminate manual A/R tasks - See how AI-powered chasing and dunning automate follow-ups and task management - Boost payment conversion - Learn strategies that increase first-payment rates by up to 28% through localized payment experiences - Gain real-time visibility - Discover how to get actionable insights into your collections and payments process - Go global seamlessly - Support 1,200+ payment methods across 174 currencies while reducing FX risk
This session is packed with practical strategies for finance teams looking to accelerate cash flow and improve customer experience—all while integrating seamlessly with Dynamics 365.
Ready to Transform Your A/R Process? Whether you're expanding globally or simply want to reduce manual A/R tasks, our team can show you how these solutions apply to your specific situation.
Schedule a brief consultation <[[https://meet.yesware.com/me/griffin-ortale/30min]]> or reply with any questions.
Best regards, Griffin Ortale
P.S. The strategies shared in this webinar are helping finance teams worldwide get paid faster and more efficiently. Don't let manual processes hold your team back. Flywire Global Headquarters 141 Tremont Street, Boston, MA 02111 United States
